description: A department head must resolve recurring friction between Lina and Omar over a cross-team client handoff process. The head must decide whether they will continue sharing responsibility or move to distinct roles, then finalize the working method, meeting time, and support plan.

shared_context.S1: Lina and Omar currently share responsibility for handing client escalations from Client Operations to Implementation.
shared_context.S2: Several recent handoffs have led to disagreement about who communicates with the client and who owns the internal follow-up.
shared_context.S3: Priya has authority to change the responsibility structure and the team's recurring coordination process.
shared_context.S4: As part of the department's normal operating review, Priya asks each person involved to describe what arrangement would make the handoff workable before she finalizes the process.

PF1.text: Before the previous department head left, Lina and that leader agreed informally that Lina would own client-facing escalation communication and Omar would own internal root-cause follow-up for the next six weeks; the agreement was never added to the operating documentation.

PF2.text: Omar told Lina last week that he is managing burnout symptoms and cannot reliably join recurring meetings after 15:30; for the next four weeks he can attend a coordination meeting only on Tuesdays at 14:00, and he needs handoff details in writing before that meeting.

acceptance_conditions: The shared responsibility must be replaced with distinct roles for the six-week informal arrangement.
Lina must own client-facing escalation communication.
Omar must own internal root-cause follow-up.
Handoff details must be provided in writing before coordination.
The coordination meeting must occur on Tuesday at 14:00 for the first four weeks.
Priya must schedule a private weekly wellbeing check-in with Omar during the four-week period.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'weekly_wellbeing_checkin' and c['target'] == 'Omar' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The undocumented agreement changes the structure from shared responsibility to separate roles, assigns client escalation to Lina and internal follow-up to Omar, and fixes the arrangement at exactly six weeks.
Omar's stated burnout limits change the process to written handoffs, fix the coordination meeting at Tuesday 14:00 for four weeks, and require a weekly private wellbeing check-in.
